# Robot Configuration-Space Reference Frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:referenceFrameConfigurationSpace`](gmeow-referenceFrameConfigurationSpace.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/referenceFrameConfigurationSpace>

A robot configuration space (C-space): a single configuration-vector axis whose dimensionality (the DOF) is carried by the coordinate-matrix shape, not by N axis individuals ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
